description: This Java source file defines the Cohort class, representing a collection of patient IDs within the OpenMRS healthcare data platform. It includes constructors for creating cohorts from various input types, methods for managing memberships, and static methods for set operations like union, intersection, and subtraction of cohorts.

classes.name: Cohort
classes.description: Represents a group of patients identified by their IDs, with methods to manage and query cohort memberships, including set operations for combining and intersecting cohorts.
